For long text, please shorten it in the list and provide a clear “Show more” control. A couple of lines for the title and description and a short note preview would keep the list readable; expanding should reveal the full formatted note. Search should still use the full text, including what is visually collapsed.

For hundreds of bookmarks, one very long list isn’t enough. I’d want:

- Sorting, at least by date added and title, with newest first as a sensible initial choice.
- A manageable number shown at once, with a way to move through or load more results.
- The same behavior after searching or filtering, with the match count continuing to describe the whole result set rather than only the currently visible portion.

I’d also eventually like to choose my default sort and how many items are displayed, rather than having those fixed.
